accounts_normal_balance_check.name: accounts_normal_balance_check
accounts_normal_balance_check.value: "core"."accounts"."normal_balance" = case when "core"."accounts"."type" in ('asset', 'expense') then 'debit' else 'credit' end

accounts_purpose_check.name: accounts_purpose_check
accounts_purpose_check.value:
split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 2) = "core"."accounts"."purpose" and split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 1) || ':' || "core"."accounts"."type" = case "core"."accounts"."purpose"
        when 'provider_clearing' then '1000:asset'
        when 'provider_float' then '1010:asset'
        when 'bank' then '1100:asset'
        when 'settlement_in_transit' then '1200:asset'
        when 'fx_clearing' then '1900:asset'
        when 'merchant_payable' then '2000:liability'
        when 'merchant_reserve' then '2010:liability'
        when 'refund_payable' then '2100:liability'
        when 'tax_payable' then '2200:liability'
        when 'fee_revenue' then '4000:revenue'
        when 'fx_revenue' then '4100:revenue'
        when 'provider_fee_expense' then '5000:expense'
        when 'loss_writeoff' then '5100:expense'
        when 'suspense' then '9000:asset'
      end

accounts_scope_check.name: accounts_scope_check
accounts_scope_check.value:
case
        when "core"."accounts"."purpose" in ('merchant_payable', 'merchant_reserve')
          then "core"."accounts"."merchant_id" is not null and "core"."accounts"."provider" is null and split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 3) ~ '^mch_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$'
        when "core"."accounts"."purpose" in ('provider_clearing', 'provider_float')
          then "core"."accounts"."merchant_id" is null and "core"."accounts"."provider" is not null and split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 3) = "core"."accounts"."provider"
        when "core"."accounts"."purpose" = 'bank'
          then "core"."accounts"."merchant_id" is null and "core"."accounts"."provider" is null and split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 3) ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{2,40}$'
        else "core"."accounts"."merchant_id" is null and "core"."accounts"."provider" is null and split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 3) = ''
      end

transaction_events_status_check.name: transaction_events_status_check
transaction_events_status_check.value: ("core"."transaction_events"."from_status" is null or "core"."transaction_events"."from_status" in ('created', 'requires_action', 'processing', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired')) and "core"."transaction_events"."to_status" in ('created', 'requires_action', 'processing', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired')

transactions_failure_check.name: transactions_failure_check
transactions_failure_check.value:
("core"."transactions"."failure_code" is null or ("core"."transactions"."failure_code" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$' and "core"."transactions"."status" in ('failed', 'cancelled', 'expired')))
        and ("core"."transactions"."failure_reason" is null or "core"."transactions"."failure_code" is not null)

checkout_sessions_complete_check.name: checkout_sessions_complete_check
checkout_sessions_complete_check.value:
("core"."checkout_sessions"."status" = 'complete') = ("core"."checkout_sessions"."completed_at" is not null)
        and ("core"."checkout_sessions"."status" <> 'complete' or "core"."checkout_sessions"."payment_id" is not null)

idempotency_keys_completed_check.name: idempotency_keys_completed_check
idempotency_keys_completed_check.value: "core"."idempotency_keys"."status" <> 'completed' or ("core"."idempotency_keys"."response_status" is not null and "core"."idempotency_keys"."response_body" is not null)

holds_end_state_check.name: holds_end_state_check
holds_end_state_check.value:
("core"."holds"."state" = 'captured') = ("core"."holds"."captured_at" is not null and "core"."holds"."capture_key" is not null)
        and ("core"."holds"."state" = 'released') = ("core"."holds"."released_at" is not null and "core"."holds"."release_key" is not null)
        and ("core"."holds"."state" = 'expired') = ("core"."holds"."expired_at" is not null)
        and ("core"."holds"."capture_key" is null or "core"."holds"."state" = 'captured')
        and ("core"."holds"."release_key" is null or "core"."holds"."state" = 'released')

outbox_published_check.name: outbox_published_check
outbox_published_check.value: "core"."outbox"."published_at" is null or "core"."outbox"."locked_at" is not null

reserve_entries_release_check.name: reserve_entries_release_check
reserve_entries_release_check.value: "core"."reserve_entries"."released_at" is null or "core"."reserve_entries"."release_batch_id" is not null

settlement_batches_amounts_check.name: settlement_batches_amounts_check
settlement_batches_amounts_check.value:
"core"."settlement_batches"."gross_minor" >= 0 and "core"."settlement_batches"."refund_minor" >= 0 and "core"."settlement_batches"."fee_minor" >= 0
        and "core"."settlement_batches"."reserve_minor" >= 0 and "core"."settlement_batches"."reserve_release_minor" >= 0
        and "core"."settlement_batches"."dispute_hold_minor" >= 0 and "core"."settlement_batches"."aml_hold_minor" >= 0 and "core"."settlement_batches"."shortfall_minor" >= 0
        and "core"."settlement_batches"."payable_draw_minor" >= 0 and "core"."settlement_batches"."min_payout_minor" >= 0

settlement_batches_approval_check.name: settlement_batches_approval_check
settlement_batches_approval_check.value:
("core"."settlement_batches"."status" not in ('approved', 'releasing', 'paid') or ("core"."settlement_batches"."approved_by" is not null and "core"."settlement_batches"."approved_at" is not null))
        and ("core"."settlement_batches"."approved_by" is null or "core"."settlement_batches"."submitted_by" is null or "core"."settlement_batches"."approved_by" <> "core"."settlement_batches"."submitted_by")

settlement_batches_release_check.name: settlement_batches_release_check
settlement_batches_release_check.value:
("core"."settlement_batches"."status" not in ('releasing', 'paid') or ("core"."settlement_batches"."payout_ref" is not null and "core"."settlement_batches"."payout_transaction_id" is not null and "core"."settlement_batches"."released_at" is not null))
        and ("core"."settlement_batches"."status" <> 'paid' or "core"."settlement_batches"."paid_at" is not null)

provider_statement_rows_matched_check.name: provider_statement_rows_matched_check
provider_statement_rows_matched_check.value:
("core"."provider_statement_rows"."match_status" in ('matched_reference', 'matched_amount')) = ("core"."provider_statement_rows"."matched_transaction_id" is not null)
        or "core"."provider_statement_rows"."match_status" in ('mismatch', 'duplicate')

reconciliation_exceptions_resolution_che.name: reconciliation_exceptions_resolution_check
reconciliation_exceptions_resolution_che.value:
("core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."status" in ('open', 'investigating')) = ("core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."resolution" is null)
        and ("core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."status" = 'written_off') = ("core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."resolution" = 'written_off')
        and ("core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."resolution" is null or "core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."resolution" in ('matched_manually', 'corrected_with_reversal', 'written_off'))
        and ("core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."resolution" is null) = ("core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."resolved_at" is null)
        and ("core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."resolution" is null) = ("core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."resolved_by" is null)

reconciliation_resolution_requests_decis.name: reconciliation_resolution_requests_decision_check
reconciliation_resolution_requests_decis.value:
("core"."reconciliation_resolution_requests"."status" = 'pending') = ("core"."reconciliation_resolution_requests"."decided_by" is null and "core"."reconciliation_resolution_requests"."decided_at" is null)
        and ("core"."reconciliation_resolution_requests"."decided_by" is null or "core"."reconciliation_resolution_requests"."decided_by" <> "core"."reconciliation_resolution_requests"."requested_by")
        and ("core"."reconciliation_resolution_requests"."status" <> 'approved') = ("core"."reconciliation_resolution_requests"."entry_ref" is null)

kyc_documents_review_check.name: kyc_documents_review_check
kyc_documents_review_check.value:
("core"."kyc_documents"."status" = 'uploaded') = ("core"."kyc_documents"."verified_by" is null)
        and ("core"."kyc_documents"."status" = 'uploaded') = ("core"."kyc_documents"."verified_at" is null)
        and ("core"."kyc_documents"."status" = 'rejected') = ("core"."kyc_documents"."rejection_reason" is not null)

kyc_parties_ownership_check.name: kyc_parties_ownership_check
kyc_parties_ownership_check.value: "core"."kyc_parties"."ownership_bps" is null or ("core"."kyc_parties"."kind" = 'ubo' and "core"."kyc_parties"."ownership_bps" between 1 and 10000)

kyc_profiles_approved_check.name: kyc_profiles_approved_check
kyc_profiles_approved_check.value: "core"."kyc_profiles"."status" <> 'approved' or ("core"."kyc_profiles"."expires_at" is not null and "core"."kyc_profiles"."reviewed_by" is not null and "core"."kyc_profiles"."reviewed_at" is not null)

aml_alerts_resolved_check.name: aml_alerts_resolved_check
aml_alerts_resolved_check.value:
("core"."aml_alerts"."status" in ('closed_false_positive', 'closed_confirmed')) = ("core"."aml_alerts"."resolved_at" is not null)
        and ("core"."aml_alerts"."status" in ('closed_false_positive', 'closed_confirmed')) = ("core"."aml_alerts"."resolved_by" is not null)

aml_blocks_lifted_check.name: aml_blocks_lifted_check
aml_blocks_lifted_check.value:
("core"."aml_blocks"."status" = 'lifted') = ("core"."aml_blocks"."lifted_at" is not null)
        and ("core"."aml_blocks"."status" = 'lifted') = ("core"."aml_blocks"."lifted_by" is not null)

aml_cases_closed_check.name: aml_cases_closed_check
aml_cases_closed_check.value:
("core"."aml_cases"."status" = 'closed') = ("core"."aml_cases"."outcome" is not null)
        and ("core"."aml_cases"."status" = 'closed') = ("core"."aml_cases"."closed_at" is not null)
        and ("core"."aml_cases"."status" = 'closed') = ("core"."aml_cases"."closed_by" is not null)

disputes_hold_check.name: disputes_hold_check
disputes_hold_check.value:
"core"."disputes"."hold_minor" >= 0 and "core"."disputes"."shortfall_minor" >= 0 and "core"."disputes"."hold_minor" + "core"."disputes"."shortfall_minor" = "core"."disputes"."amount_minor"
        and (("core"."disputes"."hold_minor" > 0) = ("core"."disputes"."hold_id" is not null))

disputes_resolved_check.name: disputes_resolved_check
disputes_resolved_check.value:
("core"."disputes"."status" = 'resolved') = ("core"."disputes"."outcome" is not null)
        and ("core"."disputes"."status" = 'resolved') = ("core"."disputes"."resolved_at" is not null)
        and ("core"."disputes"."status" = 'resolved') = ("core"."disputes"."resolved_by" is not null)
